Preview the request and estimated cost

parameters.content:
## Try the example locally
Import the JSON into n8n. In **Choose action and enter shot**, keep `action` set to `preview` and run the workflow. The preview shows a text-only 5-second vertical 768P request. Its estimated cost at the sample rate of $0.078 per output second is $0.39. [Check current Hailuo-2 rates](https://www.plusapi.cn/pricing?keyword=MiniMax-H3).

For a live request, create a **Bearer Auth** credential in n8n and select the same credential in both HTTP Request nodes. Enter your Qianliu Hailuo-2 token only in the credential form.

nodes.name: Create once and check by ID

parameters.content:
## Render one shot and keep its receipt
Set `action` to `create`, leave `taskId` empty and execute **once**. Each execution in create mode can start a billable render. Copy `task_id` from the response as a string. In the input node change `action` to `status`, paste the ID between the quotes, and save. Run the workflow again to check `task.status`. When it is `succeeded`, open `task.content.url`. If present, reconcile `task.usage.output_seconds` against your usage log.

If the create call times out, check your task history before submitting again. This workflow has no automatic retries or polling. Qianliu API maintains this example.
